theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_dqub_fderiv_consts
theorems.statement: ∀ (E F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (α : ℝ) (U K : Set E) (g : E → F), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 g x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 g y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ∃ S H : ℝ, 0 ≤ S ∧ 0 ≤ H ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ S) ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ g x - fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
